profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform that lets users create studio-quality videos from text, using AI-generated avatars and voiceovers across more than 160 languages, without cameras, microphones, actors, or physical studios. The company describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business and positions its tool primarily around corporate use cases such as employee training, internal communications, and learning and development. It offers features including a PowerPoint-to-video converter, an AI voice cloner, an AI script generator, a video translator, and interactive avatars, and the platform integrates with existing learning management systems for embedding video into courses and training modules.

The core product, also called Synthesia, falls in the video generation and editing category and centers on AI avatars with an associated note around likeness and consent risk. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices in 160-plus languages, with paid and enterprise tiers beyond that. The company states it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, employs both human and AI moderation, and labels AI-generated content in line with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements. The site's held facts record no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent filings at this time.
